integrity: Self-contained exact-integer verification code and finite exhaustive certificates accompany the proof; signed Walsh sums use unnormalized characters and counting measures. No independently audited certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph and its all-simple-hexagon edge-incidence counting convolution; no infinite-family conclusion. The first archived source (2004) was available as abstract only; full-text priority comparison with it remains unresolved. A different 2025 adjacency-spectrum discussion reports a discrepant cycle count, while the explicit all-simple-cycle census is independently verified by separate complete algorithms. Independent scientific audit has not occurred.
title: Exact hexagon Walsh recovery and optimal projection for the Möbius–Kantor graph
